candidates: OUTPUT_BUCKET bucket reference in the IaC template for ThumbnailerFunction
answer.explanation: Every ThumbnailerFunction invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET, so the bucket name the function resolves does not exist in eu-north-1. A NoSuchBucket error is not an authorization failure, so IAM is unlikely. The other functions (CrudApi, Uploader, Compression) complete normally with no errors. The likely cause is a misconfigured OUTPUT_BUCKET value in the live function configuration, with the IaC template as the second place to check for the wrong or missing bucket name.
